title: Fix admin authorization check for product creation

requirements.text: Debug and fix the isAdmin authorization check in the backend main.mo addProduct function to correctly validate admin permissions using the caller's session token

quotes: issue not resolved. it is still showing "Unauthorized: Only admins can add products".

acceptanceCriteria: The addProduct function successfully accepts product additions from authenticated admin users
The authorization check correctly validates the session token against stored admin sessions
No 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add products' error appears for valid admin users

requirements.text: Add console logging in the frontend ProductManagement component to capture and display the exact session token being sent with addProduct requests
acceptanceCriteria: Session token value is logged to browser console before making addProduct API call
Log output includes timestamp and token format for debugging

requirements.text: Add debug logging in backend main.mo to trace the complete authorization flow: log the incoming caller principal, session token lookup, role verification, and the exact point where authorization fails
acceptanceCriteria: Backend logs show the caller principal for each addProduct request
Backend logs indicate whether the session token was found in storage
Backend logs show the user's role retrieved from the session
Backend logs clearly identify which authorization check is failing

requirements.text: Verify that the session token is being correctly passed from the useBackendAuth hook through the useQueries addProduct mutation to the backend actor call
acceptanceCriteria: Session token from useAuth store is correctly included in the addProduct mutation payload
No token transformation or corruption occurs during the frontend-to-backend call chain

constraints: Do not modify the existing user authentication flow or session storage mechanism
Maintain backward compatibility with existing admin sessions
nonGoals: Modifying other CRUD operations (update, delete) unless they have the same issue
